# help startrcopy
startrcopy - Enable Remote Copy

SYNTAX
    startrcopy

DESCRIPTION
    The startrcopy command starts the Remote Copy Service.

AUTHORITY
    Super, Edit
    Any role granted the rcopy_start right

OPTIONS
    None.

SPECIFIERS
    None.

NOTES
    Access to all domains is required to run this command.

    This command must be executed before any other Remote Copy commands.

EXAMPLES
    The following example starts Remote Copy on a system:

        cli% startrcopy
